notes.title: KINESIS Returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353391/bef5ddc624d9cd3d1038a8a9638b76e2896b6096.png[/img]

Hello everyone! It's been quite a while since we last sent off a post for you all to see. On the bright side, I want to highlight our Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479750/KINESIS/

We've just overhauled it and made some massive changes and it's looking so much better, so check it out! Coupled with this we're also currently offering a [b]20% discount in the Steam Summer Sale[/b], which is the largest discount we've ever offered. You can now pick up KINESIS for less than £10 for the first time! I would love for many of you to join us and check out our amazing Game! 

The more attentive of you may have noticed some distinct changes in the visuals for the Game, "The Palace Update". Well, this is just a tease for you - we've just released Level 30 over this weekend, but wait there's more! I have a very happy announcement for you... The final 20 Levels for KINESIS are on their way! The plan right now is to have all of them be released before the end of this year. 

Currently the plan for us here at Cosmic Key is as follows: Alexis is continuing to work on KINESIS making more incredible levels & lots of much needed quality of life & amazing visuals (checkout Level 30, he genuinely took my breath away) and once Alexis has made more progress I will put together another Content Roadmap for us to follow. I do have to admit; we missed the Key Binding & Localization Patches for KINESIS, I am well aware of that. We do still plan to have those complete and released before the end of the year. 

As a final point on the topic of KINESIS, we have now finished the Community Speedrun Event that has been running since January. A total of 3 Ancestors remained at the end and they have been promoted in Discord with a permanent role to show their true skills within our Game. Thank you for participating and congratulations! 

Thank you to all of you that have stuck with us through these past few months, expect a Developer Diary to be released shortly giving a more in depth update on all of this information, join our Discord to get direct links to this information as it is released! 

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/4Wbc96b
YouTube Channel Link: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1X2EqvYLpUcecVHPwslDBw

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353391/ab06e095783b4280bd6b12ce64977d80a8dbd6ce.png[/img]

notes.title: The Speedrun Competition
notes.content:
Starting today is the Speedrun Competition! 
We've released a total of 23 Levels to compete in, and there are more coming in the near future! 
This week comes the Community Speedrun Event. 
With this update we bring Level Timers, Leaderboard functionality and an overhaul to the visuals of our Steam Achievements. A lot of work has gone into this patch and now we to unveil it all! We're looking forward to seeing you all compete over the coming weeks to get your name in the Game as a part of this Competition! Join our Discord for more information here: https://discord.gg/4Wbc96b

Also, read below and see our further development and progress that we are making! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353391/d1f6fd6e63d6e315ebae564ef2868606d15e5249.png[/img]

Thank you all for reading this weeks Community Post!

notes.title: KINESIS on Sale for 45 more minutes
notes.content:
KINESIS is on Sale for a further 45 minutes, thank you to everyone who has joined us on this journey in the Launch Week for our first Game! We're so excited to begin this journey and begin developing our Game alongside you guys! We've had a ton of fantastic feedback in our Discord and various other Channels that we've taken on board and altered the Game for your enjoyment, so thank you all! If you aren't aware of the current Discount, KINESIS is 10% off right now! 

Below you'll find a link to our Community Discord and our further Development Roadmap! I hope to find many more of you joining our Community and participating in the Speedrunning to get your name in the Game!

notes.title: The Speedrun Competition
notes.content:
We've been out for almost a week now and we've seen some fantastic growth around our Game and Community. We've done a total of six patches since the launch of Kinesis which is one per day! Our Team are working hard taking on feedback and making the Game much better for everyone. So thank you all for your brilliant feedback and keep it coming! 

We know that many of you aren't aware of our plans for the further development of both Kinesis and our Community so this post is here to inform you. Last week we posted our Development Roadmap for the first time and it has been very well received. We're excited to continue developing the Game alongside you; our amazing Community! 

Starting next week is the Speedrun Competition and many more updates! We're hard at work right now to deliver the Event as well as more content. We've managed to release a total of 22 Levels at the moment, and there will be more coming in the near future! Right now we're aiming for 1 Level per day, however bugfixing takes priority so sometimes we don't quite manage that. Join our Discord Community ready for next week's Speedrun Event with this link: https://discord.gg/4Wbc96b

Also, read below and see our further development and progress that we are making! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353391/d1f6fd6e63d6e315ebae564ef2868606d15e5249.png[/img]

This week comes the Community Speedrun Event. 
With this update we bring Level Timers, Leaderboard functionality and an overhaul to the visuals of our Steam Achievements. A lot of work is going into this patch right now and we plan to unveil it ASAP next week. We're looking forward to seeing you all compete over the coming weeks to get your name in the Game as a part of this Competition! Join our Discord for more information here: https://discord.gg/4Wbc96b

Thank you all for reading this weeks Community Post!

notes.title: The KINESIS Release
notes.content:
Hello to all of our new fans and welcome to the world of Kinesis! Tomorrow marks our release for the Game so I thought I'd write up our first Community Post, to go along with the release we have a short roadmap of the further development ahead of KINESIS. 

KINESIS as a project has been created and released within the last three months! And we believe that we've created an amazing product in that time. However, there is still a lot more that we want to do in the coming months, and we thought we should let you all know. The full plan is outlined below, but the TLDR is: at least 5 new Levels every 2 weeks! That's a ton of new Content for you guys! 

We here at Cosmic Key hope that you love the Game as much as we do. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353391/d1f6fd6e63d6e315ebae564ef2868606d15e5249.png[/img]

Join our Discord Community and get involved! 
https://discord.gg/4Wbc96b
